def compute_ranks(vals):
    n = len(vals)
    sorted_idx = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: vals[i])
    ranks = [0.0] * n
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and vals[sorted_idx[j]] == vals[sorted_idx[i]]:
            j += 1
        avg_rank = (i + 1 + j) / 2.0
        for k in range(i, j):
            ranks[sorted_idx[k]] = avg_rank
        i = j
    return ranks

y_ranks = compute_ranks(y_vals)
x_ranks = compute_ranks(x_vals)

mean_x = sum(x_ranks) / len(x_ranks)

var_y = sum((r - mean_y) ** 2 for r in y_ranks) / len(y_ranks)
var_x = sum((r - mean_x) ** 2 for r in x_ranks) / len(x_ranks)

result = cov / (math.sqrt(var_y * var_x)) if var_y > 0 and var_x > 0 else 0.0
